text_block_list.name: Bookstore Clerk
text_block_list.text:
The end of the line for purchasing the 
limited edition of "Monthly Twinkle: 
Legends Special Issue" is over here!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
What should I do... It's not moving at 
all. And the line behind me is just 
getting longer and longer...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Even though it's almost time for 
training.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um... excuse me. Do you hold magazines for 
customers?

text_block_list.name: Bookstore Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's tough. It looks like the stock 
will run out just from the people already 
in line.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(The limited edition bonus is a column 
where legendary era-defining Umamusume and 
their Trainers reflect on the past... 
There are insights you can only gain now, 
with the passage of time.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm so sorry, Trainer! I promise I 
will make up for this...!)

After much internal conflict, Chrono 
Genesis ended up skipping her training.
